title: Show logged-in user ID in the app header

requirements.text: Display the currently logged-in user's Internet Identity principal (user ID) at the top of the app for both normal users and admins, visible after login on all authenticated screens.

quotes: once a user or admin login, his user id should show on top of app

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, no user ID is shown in the header.
When the user is authenticated (user or admin), the header shows a label and the user’s principal (e.g., "User ID: <principal>") on all routes.
The displayed user ID uses the existing principal-formatting helper (short form), and the UI remains responsive (does not break the header layout on mobile or desktop).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change role-based routing behavior or admin authorization logic as part of this request.
Do not add new authentication providers; continue using Internet Identity only.
